dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: Violet? Violet, I didn't mean to… I'm so sorry. Are you okay?

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: It was the waves. I didn't think you'd fall like that.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I got you out, didn't I?

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: I thought I was going to die.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: It's my birthday and I thought I would die –

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: Don't say that. Please. You know I would never let anything happen to you. I love you so much.

glossary.label: What is escalating violence & gaslighting?
glossary.body: Abusers often test boundaries through sudden physical threats disguised as "jokes" or "accidents," immediately using gaslighting ("it was the waves") and intense affection to manipulate the victim into doubting their own fear and normalizing life-threatening abuse over time.

steps.quote: It was the waves. I didn't think you'd fall like that.
I got you out, didn't I?
You know I would never let anything happen to you. I love you so much.

glossary.note: Violet knows what happened ("You pushed me."), but Mango's story and sudden sweetness push her to doubt it.
